title: Which neighbours inside the strip?
hook: Which neighbours inside the strip? Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Cartesian coordinates, determinant sign, Euclidean distance.
doesNotKnow: Combine closest pairs from two halves by testing the narrow middle strip in y-order.

misconception: Solving left and right halves finds the globally closest pair automatically.
objective: Combine closest pairs from two halves by testing the narrow middle strip in y-order.

claims.text: The two recursive halves provide an upper bound on distance. Only points close to the dividing line can improve it, and y-order excludes strip neighbours already too far apart vertically.
